# Pacer specialization selection (M19-S2 wasm size). Only a wasm build whose
# selected mode is known and not greentea may omit the elastic implementation.
# Plain go with no selection keeps the full implementation, as does greentea.
# A manual -tags use of the internal tag fails. Raw -X is preserved: a
# contradictory -gc plus raw -X keeps both flags in the link plan and the raw
# value wins at link time, so the build keeps the full implementation.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# The internal tag is compiler-owned and never a user flag.
! go build -tags=logosgc.nongreentea -o $WORK/x.exe .
stderr '^go build: internal build tag "logosgc\.nongreentea" must not be set with -tags$'
! logos build -tags=logosgc.nongreentea -o $WORK/x.exe .
stderr '^logos build: internal build tag "logosgc\.nongreentea" must not be set with -tags$'

# Logos defaults to wasm on GOARCH=wasm; plain go keeps the upstream collector.
env GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm
logos build -n -a -o $WORK/x.wasm .
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=wasm'
go build -n -a -o $WORK/x.wasm .
! stderr 'logosGCMode'
env GOOS= GOARCH=

# Explicit greentea selects greentea on wasm for either command.
env GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm
go build -n -a -gc=greentea -o $WORK/x.wasm .
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=greentea'
logos build -n -a -gc=greentea -o $WORK/x.wasm .
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=greentea'
env GOOS= GOARCH=

# Raw -X is preserved without parsing: a contradictory -gc plus raw -X keeps
# both flags in the plan and the build still selects the -gc mode for the
# compiler hook while the linker keeps the last -X.
env GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm
go build -n -a -gc=wasm -ldflags=-X=runtime.logosGCMode=greentea -o $WORK/x.wasm .
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=wasm'
stderr ' -X=runtime\.logosGCMode=greentea'
env GOOS= GOARCH=

# Boolean -s/-w spellings alone build.
go build -o $WORK/x.exe -ldflags=-s .
go build -o $WORK/x.exe -ldflags=-s=true .
go build -o $WORK/x.exe -ldflags=-w=false .

-- go.mod --
module example.com/pacerselect

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

func main() {}
